pull_quotes.text: Reveling in the dynamic friendship between Octavia Spencer and Hannah Waddingham, this Ride or Die spy caper maximizes its entertainment
Ride or Die works best when it fully leans into the Thelma and Louise aspects of the central storyline

seasons.review_body: Ride or Die premiered on Prime Video with all eight episodes on July 15, and it is the best-reviewed of the summer's new arrivals: 97 percent positive across 32 critics on Rotten Tomatoes, 73 from Metacritic's 15. Hannah Waddingham plays Judith, a career assassin masquerading as a forensic accountant, opposite Octavia Spencer as Debbie, her civilian best friend dragged into the chaos once their cover unravels. The Peyton Reed-directed premiere front-loads a ski-resort knife fight and a black-tie gala crash that the rest of the season, spread across Europe and the Albanian mob's reach, never quite matches for pure kinetic pleasure. What holds is the Waddingham-Spencer chemistry: two performers who make the found-family throughline feel earned even as the plot mechanics around Bill Nighy's ruthless handler grow busier than the show needs.
